purpose: Current backend schema, raw-input and retained-test review for the fixed coverage ledger. Source completion is a separate crosswalk, never inferred from this backend audit.
review_method: Read actual adapter enum/field mappings, compiler IR serialization/validation and backend representation transitions.
Resolve each current evidence path and optional Rust test symbol; exclude omitted frontend-dependent symbols.
Run current compiler suite, source runtime suites and replay checks; old evidence is used only to locate corresponding observations.
Do not promote source records from an IR test or a compile-only corpus run. Do not expand fixed-scope support to arbitrary source/target proofs.

validation.source_runtime_policy: Source tests save/replay owned input and execute generated strict C at -O0/-O2. Original resource limits/C assertions are documented in separate fixture reports.

data_types.reason: Type/enum/constructor fields and nominal IDs are preserved with the explicit TypeMap offset for the backend Bytes slot. Declaration parameter/field arity is checked before substitution; recursive enum declarations remain supported while recursive TypeTable child references are rejected. Concrete runtime layouts are recomputed. FnSets/SetSummary metadata is copied and saved, but unresolved executable function sets and type parameters are diagnosed. Cause and Exit erase only non-runtime error-row arguments after declaration validation.

externals.reason: Target/host/module/name values are preserved as declarations. C selection uses the explicit C binding and registered adapter; host module metadata does not trigger module loading. No upstream frontend, source package or standard library is copied into compiler.

effects.reason: Effect identity, declaration arguments, labels and operation order/signatures are preserved. Label lookup keeps the labeled evidence key while handler layouts share the validated base operation ABI. Scope handlers merge conservative callback failure channels; typed results are explicitly boxed into owned Any at their ABI boundary.

functions.reason: Function flags, parameters, result, bodies and arena order are copied; C exports/aliases come from selected public roots and configuration. Existing env/defects later-stage metadata is rejected. Const identity stays exactly as received: no canonical-family reconstruction, additional monomorphization or upstream Core body edits. Generated Eq/Show remain ordinary upstream Flow bodies. Defect requirements and reachability are recomputed.

closure_and_flow.reason: Parameters, captures, nested body/sequence IDs, branch targets and failure edges are copied explicitly and structurally validated. Backend owns closure lifting, lifetime, cleanup and state-machine conversion. Native and suspending tests cover their respective representations. Raw later-stage MakeClosure/EnvGet/Dup/Drop and landing metadata are rejected; internal Drop is generated after validation to release unused results while counting lifted closure captures as uses.

fiber_and_runtime.reason: Fiber/Runtime operation identities and operands are exhaustively matched. Attempt/Await concrete Exit types, Scope failure flag, CauseKind and suspension flags are retained. Infallible CauseRaise is normalized with an explicit local failure landing and checked helper; it is not silently treated as a failing call. Runtime ShowString/DebugPrint and masking operations use existing runtime; residual Heap/runtime operations reject at input.

literal_and_identity.reason: Arena IDs and order are preserved and checked before indexing. Float serialization uses exact u64 bits, including NaN payloads and signed zero; Int64 extremes, embedded NUL and Unicode are retained. Repr is validated against concrete C storage rather than trusting input layout caches.

builtin_and_primitive.reason: Pinned upstream enum matches preserve operation identity, operands and primitive types. Source-only debug/show/panic/assert builtins are lowered by upstream and are rejected if residual backend input contains them. Scalar fieldless nominal enums support only equality/inequality in the integer representation; incompatible nominal types and enum arithmetic remain invalid.

defect_location.reason: Term::Defect.0 preserves the message operand. Term::Defect.1 is the optional assertion source location and is absent from the inherited embedded contract, matching the fixed oldfork adapter. This is not a defect landing edge and precise source-location preservation is not claimed.

record_reviews.reason: Field/variant mapping, validation and representation were reviewed under builtin_and_primitive. See the referenced schema group for the exact preservation, projection or rejection boundary.

backend_adjustments.contract: Scalar nominal enum equality uses the existing I32 representation; arithmetic and mismatched nominal enum comparisons remain invalid.
Concrete error Break enters erased failure blocks without losing the nonzero error tag. Cause/Exit non-runtime rows project explicitly before type identity normalization.

Scope callback failure flags merge across handler and actual arguments; implicit pure→fails function arguments receive checked existing coercions. Infallible Scope body narrowing requires no escaping failure and uses checked runtime coercion, not silent failure deletion.

Unused reference-valued raw Flow destinations release before the next statement, including suspension boundaries. Lifted closure capture bindings count as uses. Internal Drop emission remains separate from raw Drop input rejection.

serialization_review.envelope: format + schema_version + exact producer_revision + stage=flow + required_features=[]; unknown JSON fields/variants are rejected. Public API has no direct Deserialize bypass.
serialization_review.ids: Arena IDs use explicit integer codecs; all references, arities and structural DAG boundaries are checked before backend indexing. Enum declaration recursion is retained.
serialization_review.numbers: Float is persisted as u64 bit pattern, not a JSON floating number. Int64 extremes and string bytes including NUL are exact.
serialization_review.derived_metadata: Reachability/positions/active statements/type intern caches/type parameter caches/expanding enums/scope flags are excluded from saved input and rebuilt.
serialization_review.replay: The compile_saved_program test helper recompiles saved input and checks the complete Output before the original C harness executes. This covers represented IR operations actually present in retained successful tests, not every possible malformed input.

source_builtin_review.meaning: Actual upstream lowers source operations to ordinary Flow/runtime/defect. Custom Show, once-only side effects, original return values, escaping and immediate board hooks execute. All eight residual source builtins are rejected as raw backend input.

limitations: No copied independent frontend or core/std source tree. Upstream owns parsing, name/type/effect inference and source builtin expansion.
UPSTREAM-001 generic const family identity remains accepted upstream behavior; runtime per-specialization outcomes are tested but cross-specialization one-time sharing is not claimed.
Precise assertion source location is not preserved by the inherited embedded contract, matching the fixed old adapter.

High-level source/CLI replay public roots require concrete boundaries; direct Evidence parameters/results require an explicit source wrapper. Low-level owned-IR Evidence ABI tests remain a separate explicit contract.
Raw later-stage nodes and arbitrary unresolved executable type/effect sets are rejected; verified diagnostic contexts do not mean C generation accepts them.
Source operation completion and omitted mixed frontend tests must be reconciled against current source fixture/runtime reports.

source_crosswalk_boundary.pending_meaning: A pending row is deliberately not decided by this backend-only review. Final source status and current source evidence are merged separately in docs/compiler-coverage.json; this report does not override that final ledger.
source_crosswalk_boundary.make_closure: Value::MakeClosure is a later-stage raw node rejected at the Flow input boundary. Ordinary source Closure is implemented through FnRef plus ClosureMetadata; successful source closures do not prove acceptance of raw MakeClosure.
source_crosswalk_boundary.on_fail_handle: OnFail::Handle is an accepted owned-IR input form with a local handler normalization test; upstream from_core uses failure blocks/Break instead. Its direct operation coverage is IR-only.
source_crosswalk_boundary.type_param: Type::Param survives in generic declaration schemas; executable runtime-value parameters must be concrete after upstream specialization and backend substitution.
source_crosswalk_boundary.bytes: Bytes operations come from validated Emelino.Bytes source declarations because the pinned official frontend has no primitive Bytes type.
source_crosswalk_boundary.evidence: Source internal evidence is supported. High-level CLI source and replay configuration reject direct Evidence parameters/results on public roots. The lower-level owned-IR API deliberately retains explicit Evidence C-ABI fixtures that test lookup lifetime and invalid pointers; they are not evidence of source public-root support.
source_crosswalk_boundary.retire: RuntimeOp::Retire is emitted by the official from_core handler lowering and has source and owned-IR lifecycle observations.
